rawPayload.Product_Description_Legacy: The perfect drink awaits! Our 15" 1 Class Clear Ice Machine provides unsurpassed performance, delivering up to 55 lbs. of ice per day and a storage capacity of 25 lbs. of ice. U-Line s 1 Class Clear Ice Machine features U-Choose(TM) ice fullness adjustability. This model is available with black, white, stainless steel or integrated door finishes that accept a custom door panel to match your surrounding cabinetry. Select models available with BrightShield antimicrobial lighting technology. Models with BrightShield not yet available in Canada.
rawPayload.Features_Legacy:
• Industry Exclusive: U-Choose(TM) feature allows you to select ice fullness
  • Produces up to 55 lbs of ice per day
  • Stores up to 25 lb of ice
  • Silent setting temporarily suspends ice making for 3 hours
  • Indicator alert notifies user when cleaning is needed
  • Easiest clear ice machine cleaning process in the industry
  • White interior
  • Digital touch pad control
  • Bright white LED lighting
  • Stainless steel handle (7 8" diameter)
  • Integrated model requires 3 4" custom door panel and handle (not supplied by U-Line)
  • Field reversible door is shipped right-hand hinged
  • Built-in or freestanding
  • Four adjustable leveling legs
  • Factory installed drain pump model required if a gravity drain is not accessible
  • Clear heavy duty ice scoop included
  • Makes clear cubes approx. 7 8" W x 7 8" H x 7 8" L
